subject.title: [Bug]: When openclaw sends a link with an underscore to Feishu, the full hyperlink cannot be displayed

question: Which path should own the Feishu underscore-URL fix: refresh/adopt an existing linked candidate, permit a new narrow same-repo replacement, or defer until Feishu live proof is available?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the issue is already paired with open conflict-marked fork PRs and labeled no-new-fix-pr, so automation should not spawn another repair without maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt or refresh a linked candidate
options.body: Use the best existing candidate as source, resolve conflicts, require focused Feishu proof, and land the fix through a same-repo PR.

options.title: Allow a new narrow replacement
options.body: Clear the no-new-fix-pr path and let a repair worker create a fresh plugin-local PR with regression tests and source-candidate credit.

options.title: Defer for live Feishu proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer or contributor can verify the renderer behavior in a real Feishu tenant and choose the final normalization shape.

recommendation.title: Adopt or refresh a linked candidate
recommendation.body: Use the best existing candidate as source, resolve conflicts, require focused Feishu proof, and land the fix through a same-repo PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu send-path maintenance and release provenance make this the best available routing owner for choosing the fix path.
